title: The 100-point game nobody has ever seen
description:
March 2, 1962. Hershey, Pennsylvania. No TV cameras, no New York reporters, 4,124 fans. Wilt Chamberlain scored 100 points in a single NBA game - and no film of it has ever been found. Only the fourth-quarter radio call survives, plus a box score and one photograph, taken by an AP photographer who wasn't working that night.
That same season Wilt AVERAGED 50.4 points per game. In 64 years, the closest anyone has come to 100 is 83 (Bam Adebayo, 2026); Kobe Bryant's 81 held second place for twenty years before that.
